description: Get one Packrift product by SKU (or product handle): specs such as inside size, material, strength and pack count, live price and price per unit, stock, whether a quantity can ship now, volume pricing, nearby sizes and the product link. Use after search_products or find_packaging_for_item when the buyer wants more detail before choosing.

handle.description: Product handle from a product URL, if you have it instead of a SKU.

quantity.description: Optional number of packs the buyer wants, to check it can ship now.

response_format.description: concise (default) returns the essentials. detailed returns the full catalog record; use it only when a field you need is missing.

name: get_product
title: Get Packrift product details
